summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Investigation summary  I traced the full watchlist read/write path before proposing anything (no edits made):  - **Client** (`client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`): fetches via `credentials: "include"`, no localStorage/anonymous-id fallback, no client-supplied user or watchlist id. - **Server** (`modules/watchlist/handlers.ts:12-20`): every route requires a valid `arca_session` cookie, resolves it to a real user via `getSession()`, and scopes every query by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)`. No default/guest/shared watchlist exists (`schema.ts`: `user_id` is `NOT NULL
